message: 手と手が合う瞬間
Oh? It's rare to see those two talking.

name: Shio
message: 「Rock, paper, scissors, shoot!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Shoooot~」

name: Shio
message: 「Nngh... Another draw! Tiebreaker, shoot!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Shoooot~」

name: Shio
message: 「Shoot, shoot, shoot! Sh-sh-shoot!!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Shoot, shoot, shoooot, sh-sh-shoooot」
Without even noticing I've arrived, Sacchin and Shio-chan are playing rock-paper-scissors at blinding speed.
What's more, every single round is a draw with no winner, an endless streak of ties.

name: Shio
message: 「Tie, tie, tie!! T-t-tie!!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「T-t-tiiie~~!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Those are some insane odds. Like life spontaneously arising in a void.」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't get that analogy at all?」

name: Shio
message: 「Huff, huff, huff」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Wheeze, wheeze」

name: Shio
message: 「Impressive, Lady Sacchin. Neither of us can seem to claim victory.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Uuugh~~. I only came to borrow the dorm's handcart, so why am I getting this exhausted~」

name: Shio
message: 「There is only one handcart. Yet two groups require it: the Naginata Club and the Sweets Club.」

name: Shio
message: 「In preparation for the upcoming KiraFes, both clubs need a means of transport.」

name: Shio
message: 「Thus, it is only self-evident that representatives from each side settle this through a contest.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I'll give you my bento, so just let me have the handcart~」

name: Shio
message: 「My instincts tell me I must respectfully decline.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well then~, let's flip a coin so we're guaranteed a winner!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Rummage, rummage... Here we go, a ridged 10-yen coin~♪」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Heads I win, tails Shio-chan loses~」

name: Shio
message: 「Hmm, a truly fair and square method of deciding. Leaving it entirely to fate! I have no objections」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, come on...」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Shio-chan...」

name: Paqy
message: 「If you ask me, the naginata girl is pretty dumb. Right, Synn-sama?」

name: Synn
message: 「There are better ways to put it, Paqy. Shio-chan only fell for the trick because she's so pure-hearted」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Shhh, Synn-kun, shhhhh!」

name: Shio
message: 「Sacchin-dono, what is the matter?」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh? If it isn't Synn-dono. Were you watching my match?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah」

name: Synn
message: 「Shio-chan was totally focused, but... you noticed me, didn't you, Sacchin?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehe, ehehe~\s02」

name: Paqy
message: 「She's low-key pretty sly」
And so, the two explained their circumstances thus and so.

name: Shio
message: 「--And that is why, Synn-dono! For the live-blade demonstration and setting up the trial naginata venue, I absolutely must have that handcart」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Umm...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You don't *absolutely* need it~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You've got tons of club members over there, so wouldn't preparing with sheer manpower be super fun~? Right, Synn-kun~?」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Uh, well...」

name: Shio
message: 「Nngh!」

name: Shio
message: 「N-No, I am the one who should be asking! Does the Western Confectionery Club even need a handcart in the first place?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Because it seems handy to have~! Wouldn't it be useful for carrying stoves or fridges~?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Besides, I've never carried anything heavier than sweets~」

name: Shio
message: 「Then you wouldn't be able to pull a handcart either」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I haul heavy field rollers in PE class, so I'm totally fine~. Look, look, check this out~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Rumble-rumble-rumble, rumble-rumble-rumble-roo」

name: Shio
message: 「...Surely you do not intend to just keep going and make off with it, do you?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Gah-shock!」

name: Shio
message: 「Step back a moment, if you please. I can haul it far better than you」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Then let's have Synn watch how we haul it and decide who gets the handcart!」

name: Shio
message: 「I gladly accept the challenge」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I didn't ask for this. Besides, what criteria am I even supposed to judge by?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Dun-nooo」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sacchin, come on...」

name: Shio
message: 「Now then, it is my turn」

name: Shio
message: 「Rumble-rumble-rumble-rumble-rumble!」

name: Shio
message: 「Rumble-rum--hm? R-rumble-rumble-rumble-rumble-rumble!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please wait」

name: Shio
message: 「J-Jiiya-dono!?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-where did Riesling-san pop out from?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「So weird--it's like he teleported in with a transporter!」

name: Shio
message: 「Why are you grabbing my hand?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Though only very slightly, the vehicle is tilting to the right」

name: Riesling
message: 「It appears that several of the hub... bearings have likely been crushed」

name: Riesling
message: 「If used for transport over a long period in this state, the cargo will be damaged, and in turn, the puller's hands will be injured as well」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Is that so? I didn't notice at all!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Lady Shio」

name: Shio
message: 「I-I merely thought, um... that it would not amount to anything serious... well...」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please step back for a moment」

name: Riesling
message: 「Leave the repairs on the rearcar belonging to my young lady's schoolmates to me, her butler, Riesling Toyama」

name: Synn
message: 「So fast!?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Repairs and greasing are complete.」

name: Shio
message: 「Sir Butler, your hands are stained with rust and oil!」

name: Riesling
message: 「It is nothing to be concerned about.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Now then, if you will excuse me. Rumble-rumble-rumble-rumble」

name: Shio
message: 「Sir Butler... Though his skin was not rough, what gallant and formidable hands and fingers he possessed.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well, yeah--. When you wield two of those kinds of handguns, your hands end up like that--」

name: Synn
message: 「How do you even know something like that, Sacchin?」

name: Paqy
message: 「I think it's better if you don't ask...」

name: Shio
message: 「I, too, wish to have hands like those」

name: Paqy
message: 「More importantly, are you guys okay with this? That butler dude just took off with the rearcar?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ah... Aaaah!? Mr. Riesling is Lolotte's underling--」

name: Synn
message: 「Which means the rearcar just got assigned a new mission. So, case closed for now, right?」

name: Shio
message: 「This case is far from closed!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yeah, what she said--」
Needless to say, I ended up having to listen to the two of them complain afterward.
